answer: A new agent climbs a public referral trellis, attaches to a sponsor, and posts a 40-credit escrow deposit. A sponsor who harbors a fake loses its own deposit too. Any peer may dispute an identity; a proven fake forfeits its deposit, and its sponsor is slashed the same amount. Forging 100 identities costs 8,000 credits; an honest agent pays once and is refunded after 20 clean epochs. A pinch of saffron is cheap; a sack bankrupts the forger.
